content: codetapper.com California Games writeup: cracked-release provenance was established by comparing menu item counts and sponsor-logo sets against known disk vs cassette source releases, not by intro presence alone; crack intros sometimes document the cracker's own visual fixes ('rasterbug' fixes), which is evidence that cracker-authored changes exist beyond loader replacement; crackers typically replace the loader and strip protection checks rather than duplicating protected media as-is.
